about.heading: Passionate about craft and clarity
about.bio1: I'm Alex Morgan, a full-stack developer with over five years of experience building products that people love. My work sits at the intersection of engineering and design.
about.bio2: I care deeply about the details — from pixel-perfect interfaces to clean, maintainable code. When I'm not building, I'm reading, hiking, or experimenting with new technologies.

bio.heading: Designer & developer with a passion for clean, intuitive experiences
bio.p1: I craft digital products that solve real problems. With a background in both design and development, I bridge the gap between aesthetics and functionality to create seamless user experiences.
bio.p2: I believe great design is invisible—it works so well that users don't think about it. Every pixel, interaction, and word choice serves a purpose.
bio.p3: When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new tools, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing what I've learned with the community.
